title: Typography Analysis
content: Selecting fonts for Fitness and Health Technology brand voice...

title: Font Pairing
content: Montserrat + Inter: Montserrat's geometric shapes convey a modern, high-energy fitness aesthetic, while Inter provides the technical precision required for a health-tech interface. Together, they feel professional and highly streamlined.

title: Font Pairing
content: Bebas Neue + Source Sans 3: Bebas Neue is a high-impact, condensed typeface that demands attention and implies 'maximizing results' through its vertical strength. Pairing it with Source Sans 3 maintains a direct, accessible, and functional voice for body content.

title: Font Pairing
content: Space Grotesk + DM Sans: Space Grotesk offers an innovative, tech-forward personality that highlights the brand's cutting-edge nature. DM Sans balances this with a clean, friendly, and low-friction readability that makes health data feel accessible.

title: Typography Strategy
content: The typography strategy for Evergreen focuses on high-contrast sans-serif pairings to bridge the gap between human movement and digital precision. By using bold, geometric headers alongside highly legible, neutral body fonts, the brand communicates efficiency and innovation. These choices reflect a results-oriented mindset while maintaining the 'accessible' and 'streamlined' mood necessary for a modern health-technology platform.

title: Logo Architecture
content: Defining logo structure options for Fitness and Health Technology...

title: Structure Option
content: Combination Mark: This structure is ideal for fitness technology because it pairs a distinct icon—representing movement or data—with the brand name. It ensures the brand is recognizable even when only the icon is displayed on app icons or wearable device screens.

title: Structure Option
content: Abstract Mark: Fitness brands often rely on symbols of energy, speed, and growth. An abstract mark can convey these feelings of momentum and 'flow' in a modern, tech-forward way that isn't limited by literal imagery.

title: Structure Option
content: Wordmark: A clean, sans-serif wordmark communicates professionalism and clarity, which is essential for health tech. It works well for established brands that want to emphasize their name and technological precision across digital platforms.
